incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGING oncall-sre - High error rate on canary rollout for model rdx-13b-v2 in us-west-2. 5xxs + fallback thrash detected. Auto-escalation triggered.
neha: acked. jumping in. oncall-sre, grabbing context now. what's the impacted surface? customer-facing generation endpoints?
samir: yes, traffic was ramping canary -> 10%. errors show up as `model-mismatch` from router when fallback fires. some requests fall back to a regional variant then get re-routed back to canary -> loop.
maria: seeing same in traces. KV cache misses then sticky fallback selects a different variant `rdx-13b-quant` that can't handle some tokenization flags -> 500 from runtime. logs:
```
2026-03-15T20:01:12Z router WARN route=canary fallback=sticky variant=rdx-13b-quant err=model_mismatch token_format=unknown
2026-03-15T20:01:13Z runtime ERROR variant=rdx-13b-quant panic: tokenizer: unsupported special token
```
jake: customer-impact: a handful of mid-tier customers are seeing degraded completions (~8-12% error on their requests). Not a full outage but significant degradation for realtime features. CS already notified for top accounts.
neha: pulling routing policy for this canary. looks like rollout policy: canary_weight=10, fallback_policy=sticky_affinity->regional_variant->lower_tier. sticky TTL=30s. That TTL looks too long for canary churn.
eve: has anyone seen sticky fallback select a different architecture variant (fp16 vs quant) before? this mismatch seems dangerous for new tokenization flags.
samir: yes, sticky binds by route+customer, not by model-variant-compat. bug: router treats variant compatibility only at initial decision, not when selecting sticky fallback. result: sticky affinity can point at incompatible variant.
neha: immediate mitigation: pause canary rollout. set canary_weight=0. Jake, can you pause the rollout in the control plane? I don't have perms in prod UI.
jake: doing now. CLI:
```
redwoodctl rollout update --model rdx-13b --canary-weight 0 --env prod
```
...done. API returned 200. UI reflects canary paused.
incident-bot: ACTION LOG: rollout pause command issued by jake at 2026-03-15T20:07:45Z
maria: next: disable sticky fallback TTL or change fallback policy to non-sticky (immediate regional failover) to let router choose compatible variant each request.
eve: +1. Short term we should set fallback_policy=regional_variant_no_sticky. Who can change policy quickly?
samir: I can push a policy override at routing layer. Will toggle sticky->false for the affected route. syntax:
```
routingctl set-fallback --route /v1/generate --sticky false --route-filter model:rdx-13b
```
samir: doing it now.
neha: heads-up to watch for sudden drop in success if we drop sticky; might increase latency as more cold starts. monitor latency SLOs.
samir: override applied. router config checksum changed -> 0a3f9b. Logs show new decisions choosing `rdx-13b-v2` and `rdx-13b-fp16` only when compatible.
incident-bot: METRIC UPDATE: error-rate on /v1/generate down from 10.2% -> 1.3% over 2m post-override.
jake: CS updated. Notifying top impacted customers we mitigated and paused the canary; follow-up planned.
eve: root cause summary: sticky_affinity didn't record per-variant compatibility metadata. When fallback picked a region variant it could be incompatible for new tokenizer flags, causing runtime 500s. Sticky TTL prolonged the bad mapping and caused oscillation.
eve: recommended next steps:
- create a router validation that rejects sticky binding to incompatible variants
- add variant_compatibility tag and check at sticky rebind
- add shorter default sticky TTL for canaries (<=5s)
- run canary in staging with new tokenizer flags before prod rollout
maria: I can own the router validation task. ETA 2 days for spec + prod patch. Will open PR and link in thread.
neha: Samir, can you follow up with a postmortem doc describing mitigation timeline and customer impact stats? Add suggested followups and signal risk to rollout owners.
samir: will do. Assigning follow-up: PMs for rdx-13b rollout (cc @maria @jake). I'll draft PM and postmortem with timeline.
incident-bot: INCIDENT: severity=sev2 status=mitigated assigned=neha,samir,maria start=2026-03-15T20:01:12Z mitigated=2026-03-15T20:12:14Z
neha: thanks everyone. keep eyes on related jobs for 24h. escalate to sev1 if error spikes >3x baseline or if SLA customers see >5% errors.
jake: leaving a note in runbook: "If canary triggers sticky fallback loops -> pause canary, disable sticky, apply compatibility check, resume with 1% and double-monitor" :white_check_mark:
eve: adding follow-up ticket in ops board and linking this thread.
samir: closing pager. final status: canary paused, routing override applied, customers notified, follow-ups created. Good work team. :thumbsup:
